faq.chatgpt.a: ChatGPT gives you an answer. Orqanix does the work: AI agents research, plan and make the real files on your Mac, like documents, plans, replies and code.
faq.chatgpt.q: How is this different from ChatGPT?
faq.cost.a: It’s free during the early version. We’ll publish prices before any paid plan starts.
faq.data.a: Your files and chat history stay on your Mac. Only your conversation and what the AI needs to answer go to the cloud AI. No ads, no tracking, and we don’t sell your data.
faq.models.a: Google Gemini by default. You can connect other models, such as OpenAI or Anthropic.
faq.ownership.a: You do. AI can make mistakes, so check the results before you rely on them.
faq.safety.a: You set the rules: approve every action, approve only the risky ones, or let it run. It starts in “let it run”, and you can stop any run at any moment.
faq.safety.q: Can it change or break things on my Mac?
faq.skills.a: No. Type or say what you need in plain words. It asks you when it needs something, and you review the result.
faq.start.a: A Mac with Apple M1 or newer, an internet connection and a free account. The first time you open it, macOS may block it. Go to System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway. You only do this once.
faq.start.q: What do I need to start?
faq.title: Questions
faq.tools.a: Yes. You can switch on 50+ connectors one at a time, and it works alongside your code editor.
faq.tools.q: Does it work with my other tools?
faq.uses.a: Anything that ends in a file or a finished task: a business plan, a campaign, client replies, reports, a website. Save any job as a recipe and run it again, or put it on a schedule.
faq.uses.q: What can I use it for?
